prompt: Create an original 180 second orchestral adventure instrumental composition for mystery, nocturnal exploration and restrained suspense. Mood: mysterious, tense, nocturnal. Instruments: strings, French horn, timpani, flute. Style: rising motifs, dynamic arcs and clear melodic development. Tempo approximately 94 BPM; G minor. Main idea: alternating short and long phrases. Use unresolved suspended harmony, careful space and subtle low-register movement; no jump scares. Instrumental only. No vocals, no choir, no humming, no singing, no speech, no lyrics, no vocal samples. Do not imitate any existing artist or melody. [00:00-01:00] Establish the main idea immediately with the core ensemble. [01:00-02:00] Develop the motif with a complementary instrumental counterline, preserving the intended energy. [02:00-03:00] Return to the main idea and give a musically resolved ending with a short natural tail. Finish around 03:00.

description.en: A charming and gentle instrumental piece featuring a prominent flute melody, supported by pizzicato and bowed strings, and light percussion. It evokes a whimsical and slightly melancholic atmosphere.
description.zh: 一首迷人而温柔的器乐曲，以悠扬的长笛旋律为主，辅以拨弦和弓弦乐器，以及轻柔的打击乐。营造出一种异想天开而略带忧郁的氛围。

metadataBasis: style/scenario/tempo/key/moods are prompt intent; duration is measured; energy and audioReview are model inference when energyBasis is automated-audio-review
